Based on the provided context, personal data is defined as information that is stored in text, digit, image, sound or similar forms in an electronic environment and which is associated with or helps identify a particular natural person. Personal data includes both basic personal data (such as family name, date of birth, gender, contact details, identification numbers, etc.) and sensitive personal data.

The definition also mentions that personal data protection involves acts to prevent, detect, suppress, and handle violations regarding personal data in accordance with the law.

Basic personal data specifically includes elements like:
- Family name, middle name, first name
- Date of birth/death/missing
- Gender
- Place information (birth, registration, residence)
- Nationality
- Personal photos
- Contact details (phone number, ID numbers)
